questions.stem: A full-term neonate born to a healthy mother presents on the third day of life with a birth weight of 2.9 kg, length of 50 cm, head circumference of 35 cm, heart rate of 130 bpm, respiratory rate of 50 breaths/min, and peripheral cyanosis noted on the extremities. The baby is passing urine but has not passed any stools till now. Which of the following findings in this neonate would be most concerning?

options.label: A
options.text: Peripheral cyanosis (acrocyanosis) noted on the extremities

options.label: B
options.text: Passage of the first stool after 48 hours of birth
